statement: 27estore can rout an integrated handle into a high-gloss lacquer front for SEKTION
rationale: one product image on their site is captioned as a high-gloss front with integrated handles; no specification or price for it was found. If they cannot, the fallbacks are push latches or an aluminium J-channel

mechanism.how: Ask 27estore for the handle detail, its price and a sample front in the lower colour before ordering
